items.title: 3 Dividend Stocks That Make Money When Wall Street Gets Volatile
items.summary: Most retirees chase calm, but three exchange operators collect a fee on every hedge, option, and futures trade when markets panic. Their payouts look small, yet one dividend comes with a year-end bonus and one carries a risk tied to retail traders.

items.title: Gold Trades Near 15-Month Low as Federal Reserve Rate Hike Expectations Weigh on Prices
items.summary: Gold prices declined on Wednesday, remaining close to their lowest levels in 15 months as expectations of further monetary tightening by the US Federal Reserve and a stronger dollar continued to weigh on precious metals. Investors remained cautious ahead of the publication of key US inflation figures later in the session, which could influence expectations for the central bank’s December interest rate decision.

items.title: Gold holds near 15-month lows on Fed hike bets; PCE inflation awaited
items.summary: Investing.com - Gold prices hovered near a 15-month low on Wednesday, as a stronger dollar and Federal Reserve interest rate hike expectations pressured the non-yielding metal, while investors awaited key U.S. inflation data.

items.title: How Investors May Respond To CME Group (CME) Wind Power Options Launch
items.summary: CME Group reported that MSI GuaranteedWeather and Edge Tech AG completed the first block trade in its new Wind Power Germany ERA5 100m 2019 options, part of a suite of financially settled wind power futures and options listed on NYMEX. The initial block trade in German wind power options signals early commercial use of CME Group’s environmental contracts at the same time prediction market partners face regulatory scrutiny. This brings both product expansion and legal risk into sharper focus...
